what_this_is: the PUBLIC statement of one private run, retained beside its segments so that a process that did not prove the run can rebuild the verifier's statement and check it. NOT a privacy result, and NOT an authorisation of these endpoint commitments.
digest_encoding: every digest, root, key and byte string is lower-case hex

shape.name: 125M private block (T512 / d768 / f2048, 12 heads of 64 over 4 KV heads)

public_weights.recipe: private_block::dense_tests::dense_run_case(<block profile's Shape>), the same fully dense public words for every block: SplitMix64 seeded 0xD15EED1900000001, read in the fixed order [Wq, Wk, Wv, Wo, gamma_a, gamma_m, Wg, Wu, Wd, x]; Wq/Wk/Wv/Wo uniform on [-56,-1] u [1,56]; gamma_a/gamma_m uniform on [40,127]; Wg/Wu uniform on [-96,-1] u [1,96]; Wd uniform on [-B,-1] u [1,B] with B = band_down_run(shape) (47 at the rungs, 1 at 125M); hidden input uniform on [-6000,-1] u [1,6000]
public_weights.description: deliberately public synthetic test weights, FULLY DENSE (no zero entry in any of the nine words) and regenerated from the shape by the named deterministic stream; no weight value is written into this file, and every regenerated block is checked against the block_digests the run header absorbs
